headline: Craft the frame. Keep the method.
description: Framewright is an independent AI-assisted video production studio and research lab by Anton Biletskiy-Volokh. I make films, explainers and product stories while exploring how AI tools, visual styles and production techniques work together. Each film adds findings, corrections and reusable methods to the next.

capabilities.title: Films & visual stories
capabilities.text: A product to explain, a story to tell, or a visual experiment to bring to life. Work with me on a film, from the creative direction to a publication-ready package for each screen.

capabilities.title: Tools in real production
capabilities.text: For AI platforms and tool makers: test your product in a real film, alongside other tools, styles and techniques. Useful findings can become published examples and documented workflows. Recommendations depend on the results, not the partnership.

capabilities.title: Workflows for your team
capabilities.text: Bring a repeatable video process into your business, content team or production studio. Explore tool combinations, review steps and reusable recipes around your needs and resources. Fellow creators can study, adapt and contribute to the open methods.

boundary: Today: an author-led studio and an open methods library, with selected tools running in the production environment. Team workflows are collaboration proposals; a standalone production app and automatic social publishing remain roadmap work.
